items.title: StyleSmuggler: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine (RCE)
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code due to improper neutralization of special elements in a template engine. It has a CVSS score of 10.0 and is actively being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends applying this update in addition to the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output (RCE)
items.summary: This vulnerability affects Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, Magento Open Source, and the Adobe I/O Events extension for Commerce. It is an Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output flaw that can lead to arbitrary code execution without user interaction.
